release_notes: The click path stops waiting on the disk. Web workers now keep one persistent SQLite connection instead of opening and closing one per request, which paid four disk syncs on every click (measured on network storage: a single click p50 24 ms to 3.8 ms, fdatasync per click 4.0 to 0.04); an abandoned transaction from a crashed request is rolled back before the next one, and install.sh stops php-fpm before replacing the tree so no worker writes into a deleted database file. WAL checkpoints move off the click path: the every-minute click-spool worker folds the WAL every 2 seconds in the background, web requests never checkpoint (a distant 40 MB fuse only), the WAL file is capped at 64 MB, and System status shows its size and the last checkpoint time, warning when the background task has not run for 5 minutes. server_setup v2 raises stock nginx limits (worker_connections 768/1024 to 4096, worker_rlimit_nofile 16384) - existing installs see a recommended one-command banner, hand-tuned values are never touched. The duplicate-click window is now a setting, 0-10 seconds, default 2 (unchanged); 0 records every request separately, the mode per-request load-test criteria expect. Behind it: the CPA.RIP load test of 2026-11, docs/loadtest-2026-11.
